# RitualDev — Autonomous AI Agent Defense & Governance Suite
> The enterprise-grade security, database guardrail, and context compaction suite for autonomous AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Devin, Antigravity).

## Overview
RitualDev (https://ritualdev.in) is an independent engineering platform building zero-trust kernel sandboxing, database wire proxies, and progressive token compaction to protect developer infrastructure against prompt injection, credential exfiltration, and destructive database mutations.

## Core Product Suite

### 1. AgentShield (Kernel Sandbox & Zero-Leak Defense)
- **URL**: https://ritualdev.in/agentshield/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/AgentShield
- **Purpose**: Wraps AI coding agent execution within OS-level kernel sandboxes.
- **Engines**:
  - Linux: Bubblewrap (bwrap) + Landlock LSM unprivileged user namespaces.
  - macOS: Apple Seatbelt (sandbox-exec) Scheme confinement.
  - Windows: AppContainer low-integrity execution tokens.
- **Key Features**: Synthetic decoy honeytokens for sensitive credentials (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, .env), strict CIDR egress filtering (blocks unauthorized HTTP/DNS exfiltration).
- **Install**:
  - Homebrew: `brew tap ritualdev-lab/tap && brew install agentshield`
  - Scoop: `scoop bucket add ritual && scoop install agentshield`
  - npm: `npm install -g @ritualdev-lab/agentshield`

### 2. DBShield (Database Guardrail & Wire Proxy)
- **URL**: https://ritualdev.in/dbshield/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/DBShield
- **Purpose**: Sits as a transparent wire protocol proxy (PostgreSQL wire format 3.0, SQLite) in front of developer databases.
- **Key Features**:
  - Virtual Schema Masking: Intercepts information_schema / pg_catalog queries to hide PII columns and credential tables from agent introspection.
  - Two-Phase Distributed Dry-Run Tokens: Coordinates simulated commits across multi-store architectures (Postgres + Redis + SQLite).
  - Real-time ChatOps Bot: Pushes interactive Block Kit / AdaptiveCard approval cards to Slack #db-approvals and Microsoft Teams with 1-click [Approve] / [Reject] buttons.
- **Install**: `brew install dbshield` or `npm install -g @ritualdev-lab/dbshield`

### 3. SkillPrism (Context Compactor & Shared Redis VPC Cache)
- **URL**: https://ritualdev.in/skillprism/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/SkillPrism
- **Purpose**: Progressive skill disclosure engine that cuts LLM prompt token bloat by 96.7%.
- **Key Features**:
  - Replaces unconditional JSON schema dumping with lightweight JIT semantic receipts and ephemeral schema injection.
  - Shared Team Redis VPC Cluster: Centralizes tool embeddings and cached query receipts across engineering teams running Cursor or Claude Code.
  - Deployment: Helm chart (`helm install skillprism-hub ./helm/skillprism-hub`) & Docker Compose (`docker-compose.redis-vpc.yml`).

### 4. DevShelf (Open-Source Developer Directory & MCP Catalog)
- **URL**: https://ritualdev.in/devshelf/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/DevShelf
- **Purpose**: Community directory of 565+ verified developer tools, free APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with zero paywalls.
- **API Endpoints**:
  - Tools JSON: https://ritualdev.in/api/v1/tools.json
  - Categories: https://ritualdev.in/api/v1/categories.json

### 5. WebSecAuditor (AST Taint Tracking & PR Security Bot)
- **URL**: https://ritualdev.in/web-sec-auditor/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/web-sec-auditor
- **Purpose**: Static AST taint analysis scanner and turnkey GitHub PR review bot that identifies hardcoded secrets, injection sinks, and prototype pollution with 1-click remediation patches.

### 6. MCPBuilderKit (OpenAPI-to-MCP Generator)
- **URL**: https://ritualdev.in/mcp-builder/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/mcp-builder-kit
- **Purpose**: Production scaffolding engine converting OpenAPI v3.0 / v3.1 REST specs into typed TypeScript and Python MCP servers in seconds.

### 7. Ritual Agent Defense IDE Extension
- **URL**: https://ritualdev.in/extension/
- **Open VSX**: https://open-vsx.org/extension/ritualdev-lab/ritual-agent-defense
- **Purpose**: Unified IDE extension for Cursor, VS Code, and Windsurf showing live sandbox profiles, DB mutation approvals, and token compaction analytics.
- **Install**: `code --install-extension ritualdev-lab.ritual-agent-defense`

### 8. Enterprise Governance Suite
- **URL**: https://ritualdev.in/enterprise/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/enterprise-governance-suite
- **Purpose**: AWS VPC Terraform modules and air-gapped Kubernetes Helm charts for enterprise AI agent governance. Includes automated SOC 2 cryptographic compliance PDF reporting.

## Pricing & Monetization
- **Free Open-Source Core ($0)**: All CLI tools, local kernel sandboxes, MIT/Apache licensed.
- **Pro Individual ($15/mo)**: Managed cloud audit logs, native desktop menu-bar GUI, priority MCP runner. Powered by Dodo Payments.
- **Team Cluster ($99/mo)**: Shared Redis VPC cluster, DBShield staging Slack bot, team policy synchronization.
- **Enterprise Governance ($Custom)**: On-premise air-gapped private VPC, 99.99% uptime SLA, dedicated forward-deployed solutions engineer.
